svg.title: Information-set credit and post-evidence consistency
svg.text: Training with a shared observation history
Paired rollouts receive the same credit before their histories diverge. Afterward, each world follows its own observations.

If undefined, use paired token GAE.
Each world generates its own responses

has been seen in this world (t ≥ τseen).
